subject: EvalTech bake-off: request for short-term accelerator credits
messages:
From: Sara Lowe <sara.lowe@evaltech.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, May 20, 2028 at 9:12 AM -0700
Subject: Request: extra eval credits for RFP bake-off

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the host of features in the trial — the team has been running side-by-side runs against CompetitorX and we expanded the benchmark scope this morning to include longer multi-turn dialogues and a larger knowledge snapshot. We're seeing promising differentiation, but we don't have enough runway on the current trial allocation to finish the last two benchmark cohorts.

Ask: would Redwood consider a one-time top-up of 50k token-equivalent credits and a 30-day extension to our evaluation window so we can complete the tie-breaker tests? The evaluation window currently ends next week (5/27).

Success criteria: complete three head-to-head scenarios, produce latency and cost breakdowns, and a short report for procurement. We can share the final report with Redwood.

I've attached the updated RFP timeline and a short note on our benchmarking kit. Happy to take a quick call if that's easier.

Attachments: EvalTech_RFP_Timeline.pdf

Thanks,
Sara Lowe
Head of Platform Ops
EvalTech Solutions

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lowe <sara.lowe@evaltech.com>
Date: Sun, May 20, 2028 at 11:05 AM -0700
Subject: Re: Request: extra eval credits for RFP bake-off

Sara —

Appreciate the context and the quick heads-up. We can often support short, conditional top-ups for competitive bake-offs. A couple quick clarifying Qs before I loop in ops/finance:

- Can you confirm the breakdown (how many tokens per cohort / per model variant)?
- Will this be used exclusively for benchmark runs (no production traffic)?
- Do you have an internal contact for instrumentation so we can enable cost/latency tagging on our side?

High-level proposal (we can tighten after internal review): a 30k token top-up + 30-day extension, instrumentation required, and usage cap so it can't be auto-converted to paid capacity. If you can confirm the points above I will escalate for sign-off today.

If you prefer a 15 minute call I'm available 2-4pm PT today.

—Olga
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Subject: Fwd: EvalTech - credit top-up request (urgent)

Team —

Forwarding EvalTech's ask. They expanded their head-to-head scope and are requesting 50k tokens + a date extension. My read: we should be permissive but gate with strong telemetry and a short window. Proposed terms below for approval:

Proposed terms for approval (DL-9821):
- One-time allocation: 30,000 token-equivalent credits (trial-only ledger)
- Duration: 30 days from date of grant
- Guardrails: instrumentation hook enabled; usage cap set to 30k; no conversion to paid capacity without explicit PO
- Eligibility: must run net-new benchmark cohorts (no replays of existing paid traffic); Redwood to receive final benchmark report
- Legal: customer signs MAP addendum (appendix to MSA) and accepts trial guardrail language

Attachments included: proposed-map-template.xlsx (I populated a quick MAP), EvalTech_RFP_Timeline.pdf (from customer).

Recommend we approve the 30k as a compromise — 50k feels high unless Ops approves a larger cap. If we sign off, I will send an offer to EvalTech with instrumention and DocuSign map.

Olga

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, May 21, 2028 at 2:20 PM -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: EvalTech - credit top-up request (urgent)

Olga —

Thanks for the write-up. Approve 30,000 token-equivalent credits for 30 days with these mandatory conditions:
1) Usage cap translated to a $2,500 spend ceiling (ops to enforce);
2) Customer must run net-new benchmark cohorts (we reserve right to audit results);
3) MAP addendum signed via DocuSign before credits are issued;
4) Instrumentation hooks turned on and we get token-level latency/cost per-model for the window.

Jordan — please prioritize the addendum review; Ben — pls confirm you can set the spend cap and flag the account to prevent automatic upgrade.

Marissa
VP, Commercial
Redwood Inference
